items.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Eyes $30 Billion Valuation in Australia IPO
items.summary: Data center operator Firmus Grid Ltd. is seeking a A$43.7 billion ($30.3 billion) valuation in its Australian initial public offering this month, according to terms of the deal seen by Bloomberg.
